mapper.select: SELECT ri.item_id, ri.category_id, ri.rentalShop_id, ri.item_name, ri.item_detail, ri.total_quantity, ri.item_img, ri.created_at as item_created_at, ic.item_type, ic.price_per_hour FROM rent_item ri LEFT JOIN item_category ic ON ri.category_id = ic.category_id WHERE ri.total_quantity > 0 ORDER BY ri.item_id ASC

SELECT ri.item_id, ri.category_id, ri.rentalShop_id, ri.item_name, ri.item_detail, ri.total_quantity, ri.item_img, ri.created_at as item_created_at, ic.item_type, ic.price_per_hour FROM rent_item ri LEFT JOIN item_category ic ON ri.category_id = ic.category_id WHERE ri.category_id = #{category_id} AND ri.total_quantity > 0 ORDER BY ri.item_id ASC

SELECT ri.item_id, ri.category_id, ri.rentalShop_id, ri.item_name, ri.item_detail, ri.total_quantity, ri.item_img, ri.created_at as item_created_at, ic.item_type, ic.price_per_hour FROM rent_item ri LEFT JOIN item_category ic ON ri.category_id = ic.category_id WHERE ri.item_id = #{item_id}
